title: Process Excellence Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Improve how our operations teams work.

What you'll do
- Map end-to-end processes in BPMN and measure cycle times
- Find root causes with SQL and Power BI
- Facilitate Lean workshops and track measures

What you bring
- 2+ years in process analysis, operations or consulting
- Lean or Six Sigma training
- Good English; the team language is English and B2 is enough
